The '''''Enkindle''''' was a [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] in service to the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The ''Enkindle'' was damaged during a failed incursion into Imperial space, and despite its attempt to hide in the upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Sarapin Four]], Imperial forces destroyed it there before reinforcements arrived.
